review_description: After extensive research on the web, I am confident that the panels and inverter I had installed are of good middle of the range quality although most of the technical jargon is over my head. I've done a drive by of nearby installers to see what type of business they ran to assess whether they were into Solar for the quick dollar or the long term.  I like to give work to the small local guy which I did after initial reservations. So far happy with the work, still waiting for Energex to finish connection.
